$comment: Architecture map of JavaDevBible for the next agent. Updated 2026-11-23 after the bug/improvement sweep (uncommitted at time of writing; base commit 99eb5f8). Every fact was read from the repo, but it is a snapshot: CLAUDE.md and the code win when they disagree.

project.name: JavaDevBible
project.rulesPrecedence: CLAUDE.md is authoritative over this file. Read it before editing anything.

hardConstraints: 100% static: HTML5 + CSS3 + vanilla JS + JSON. No framework, no backend, no bundler, no build step, no CMS/login/comments.
Zero dependencies in the site AND in its tooling. No package.json, no node. tools/verify.sh is pure bash on purpose.
The only Java/Maven code allowed is the separate mcp/ module; it never ships to GitHub Pages and the site must never depend on it.
No inline style="..." on content elements in topic pages. New visuals -> a named class in main.css.
No UTF-8 BOM in any HTML file (verify.sh check 3).
Every count like 'N topics' / 'N categories' in index.html, README.md, CLAUDE.md must equal disk exactly, no '+' (verify.sh check 7).

subsystems.role: The deployed product. Served as-is by GitHub Pages; also works opened from file:// except search (fetch of JSON).
Integrity checker — the project's 'compiler'. 7 checks, exits 1 on failure.
Runs verify.sh on push/PR to main and on workflow_dispatch. No setup-node, no cache. Does NOT build mcp/.

Optional Spring Boot 4.0.0 + Spring AI 2.0.0 MCP server over STDIO that exposes the site's content to AI assistants. Reads javabible/ from disk. Not deployed, not covered by CI, not mentioned in CLAUDE.md's repository structure.
subsystems.config: mcp/src/main/resources/application.properties (stdio=true, web-application-type=none, banner off, console log pattern empty, logs to javadevbible-mcp.log)

tools.name: search_topics
tools.scoring: identical to search.js (see files.javabible/js/search.js.algorithm); scores all entries, sorts, then truncates

tools.name: get_topic_content

args.topicPath: must start with 'topics/' and contain no '..'

tools.behaviour: regex-strips script/style/nav/footer/header/aside, then all tags, decodes 6 entities, collapses whitespace, truncates at 24000 chars

tools.name: list_categories
tools.behaviour: groups search-index entries by category label in insertion order

subsystems.tests: cd mcp && ./mvnw -q test  (JavaBibleToolsTest: ranking regressions against the real index)

javabible/index.html.role: Home: flat static hero (title, subtitle, stats line, search box, "Jump to" text links) + 13 numbered category cards with hand-written topic lists. Cards highlight on hover; the :target card flashes on arrival (card-landed animation) and returns to normal.
css: css/main.css (hero, stats line and Jump-to links)
javabible/index.html.cardContract:
...
  • Label
    • . verify.sh check 7 requires one card-with-id per category folder.

javabible/topics/{folder}/{page}.html.role: One self-contained topic page. 94 of them. No templating: header, TOC aside, footer and script tags are duplicated in every file.
javabible/topics/{folder}/{page}.html.headContract: charset, viewport, search-oriented <title> (<=70 chars, ends " - JavaDev Bible"), meta description (70-160), canonical, og:* incl. og:image og-card.jpg 1200x630, twitter:card summary_large_image, favicon, 3 stylesheets, JSON-LD @graph [TechArticle, BreadcrumbList Home > category > page]

javabible/data/search-index.json.role: Flat JSON array, one object per topic page. Consumed by js/search.js (browser) and mcp JavaBibleTools (server).
javabible/data/search-index.json.invariant: Set of url values == set of topics/**/*.html on disk (verify.sh check 2). verify.sh parses it with grep, so keep it flat: one "url": "..." per entry, no nesting.

javabible/js/search.js.role: Instant search. IIFE. Fetches data/search-index.json; multi-word AND search, weighted score + bonuses, sort desc then title asc, top 10 + '+N more'.
javabible/js/search.js.a11y: ARIA combobox/listbox, ArrowUp/Down/Enter/Escape, aria-activedescendant and aria-selected kept in sync, results are real <a role=option>.
javabible/js/search.js.security: No innerHTML from index data; createElement + textContent + <mark> nodes only.
javabible/js/search.js.failureMode: If fetch fails, the panel shows 'Search is unavailable' — no silent fallback. Opening index.html via file:// triggers this in most browsers.
javabible/js/search.js.panelState: data-open="true|false" on #searchResults, styled by main.css. navigation.js must NOT touch it.
algorithm: tokenize: lower-case, split on whitespace, drop 1-char words if longer ones exist
forms(token): token, plus singular if it ends in 's' and is longer than 3
per token: sum field weights where any form occurs; +wordStart if a form starts a word in the title; token with 0 -> entry excluded
multi-word: +phraseTitle if whole phrase in title, else +phraseText if in keywords/description
+titlePrefix if title starts with the phrase
sort score desc, then title asc

javabible/js/navigation.js.role: IIFE. Copy button on every pre>code (navigator.clipboard; .copied/.failed states), Ctrl/Cmd+K focuses #searchInput on the index only. In-page anchors are left to the browser on purpose: history.pushState does not update :target.
notes: Collapsibles, back-to-top and sharePage() were removed on 2026-11-23 (no page used them).
Writes no inline styles; pre { position: relative } lives in syntax-highlighting.css.

javabible/js/toc.js.role: Builds the TOC from h2/h3 inside main.topic-content into #toc-nav, generates missing heading ids (slug + index), scroll-spy via IntersectionObserver (rootMargin -80px 0 -75% 0), collapse toggle (#toc-toggle), collapsed by default at <=900px, adds .toc-ready to #toc-sidebar after init to avoid CLS.
notes: Click jumps to heading top - 16px (topic-header is not sticky) and marks the clicked link active immediately; reduced motion -> instant jump.

javabible/css/main.css.role: Everything global: CSS variables, reset, hero, search panel (.search-result-*, .is-active, mark, .search-message), category grid, footer, topic header, topic content, code blocks, .info-box variants, related topics, collapsibles, bare <table> styling, responsive, print, selection. Also: tr.row-highlight, .best-practices, print rules hiding TOC/Copy, and the index hero stats/Jump-to block (last in file).

javabible/css/syntax-highlighting.css.role: Token colours for hand-annotated code: keyword, class-name, annotation, comment, string, function, number, operator, attribute. pre { position: relative } for the Copy button. Dead classes (.code-block, .line-numbers, .language-badge, .variable…) removed.

javabible/css/toc.css.role: .topic-layout grid, sticky .toc-sidebar on desktop (>=901px), collapsible TOC on mobile, .toc-link/.toc-h2/.toc-h3/.toc-active, .toc-ready gate.
javabible/css/toc.css.breakpoint: 901px — must stay in sync with the matchMedia queries in toc.js

javabible/favicon.svg.role: Site icon, linked from every page.

javabible/sitemap.xml.role: One <url><loc> per page (95). verify.sh check 13 keeps it equal to disk.

404.html (repo root).role: GitHub Pages not-found page. Root-relative /javadevbible/... links. Not testable with python http.server.

tools/sitemap.sh.role: Regenerates javabible/sitemap.xml: one <url> per page with <lastmod> = date of the last commit touching it. Run after committing page edits.

javabible/img/og-card.jpg.role: 1200x630 share image used as og:image on every page. Generated once (outside the repo); no build step.

google1ef21d251b2206b1.html (repo root).role: Google Search Console ownership proof. Never delete/rename/edit. verify.sh check 12 fails if missing.

javabible/js/demos.js.role: IIFE. Interactive demos: fills <figure data-demo="…" hidden> placeholders and reveals them. First demo 'n-plus-one': the SQL log of one loop over 10 orders with a lazy association (10 queries, one persistence-context hit), batch fetching (2) and JOIN FETCH (1). Animates only on button press; renders at once under prefers-reduced-motion. createElement + textContent only.

skeleton: <head>: charset, viewport, <title>{Title} - JavaDev Bible</title>, <meta name="description"> (required, check 6), favicon ../../favicon.svg, 3 stylesheets
header.topic-header > .header-content > nav.breadcrumb (Home / index.html#{anchor} / Title) + h1 + p.topic-subtitle + a.back-btn
aside.toc-sidebar#toc-sidebar > .toc-header(span.toc-title + button.toc-toggle#toc-toggle) + nav.toc-nav#toc-nav (empty; filled by toc.js). Copy verbatim from relationships.html.
Section 0: what it is + why it exists + before/after code
Interview Questions: div.info-box.note '🎓 Junior level' (>=3) + div.info-box.important '🔥 Senior level' (>=3)
section.related-topics > h3 + p.related-intro + div.related-links > a.related-link > span.related-icon

components.code: <pre><code> with manual <span class="keyword"> etc. navigation.js injects a .copy-btn into every pre.
components.table: bare <table>, no class (comparison-table is banned, check 5)

categoryNamingWarning: Three different names exist per category: folder name, index.html anchor (java-versions -> #versions, best-practices -> #bestpractices), and the search-index 'category' label, which for 5 categories differs from the CLAUDE.md table (e.g. 'Advanced Java Concepts' vs 'Advanced Java'). Copy the label from an existing entry of the same folder.

steps: navigation.js adds Copy buttons, smooth-scroll handlers
toc.js reads h2/h3 of main.topic-content, fills #toc-nav, starts scroll-spy, adds .toc-ready
JavaBibleTools reads javabible/data/search-index.json and topics/*.html from disk

verifyChecks.name: Internal links
verifyChecks.what: Every local href in javabible/**/*.html resolves to a file (fragments not validated).

verifyChecks.name: Search index
verifyChecks.what: url set in search-index.json == topics/**/*.html on disk.

verifyChecks.name: UTF-8 BOM
verifyChecks.what: No HTML file starts with EF BB BF.

verifyChecks.name: Meta description
verifyChecks.what: Present on every topic page; 70–160 characters on every page.

verifyChecks.name: Hand-written counts
verifyChecks.what: Cards with id == category folders; 'N topic'/'N categor' in index.html, README.md, CLAUDE.md, mcp/README.md == disk, no '+'.

verifyChecks.name: Code blocks
verifyChecks.what: Per <pre>: <span> opens == closes, no '</tag>', only span/code/mark/b/strong/em/i/a/br tags inside.

verifyChecks.name: Undefined CSS classes
verifyChecks.what: Every class used in HTML (and 404.html) is defined in css/. Dotted names (Java classes in XML samples) ignored.

verifyChecks.name: Forbidden markup
verifyChecks.what: No style="" in topics/; no two box corners (┌…┐ ┌ / └…┘ └) on one line.

verifyChecks.name: Index cards
verifyChecks.what: Every topic page linked from index.html, no dead card links.

verifyChecks.name: SEO head
verifyChecks.what: Self-referencing canonical, og:title, og:image exists on disk, <title> <=70 chars and suffix, JSON-LD BreadcrumbList ending at the page, Search Console file at repo root.

verifyChecks.name: Sitemap
verifyChecks.what: sitemap.xml locs == index.html + topic pages on disk; every <url> has <lastmod>. Dates not compared (CI clones shallow).

verifyChecks.name: Field injection
verifyChecks.what: No '@Autowired private' in a <pre> unless the block has a test annotation or a ❌ marker.

notVerified: Page structure conventions (Section 0, Do/Don't, interview question counts)
Most Java conventions in samples (jakarta.*, LAZY, records, ProblemDetail, e-commerce domain) — only field injection is checked
Check 14 is block-level: a block mixing a test annotation with application code is not inspected
mcp/ is not built in CI

addTopicPage: Copy topics/databases/relationships.html; keep head/header/aside/footer/scripts; rewrite title, description, canonical + og:url/og:title/og:description, breadcrumb, h1, subtitle, content.
Add an entry to data/search-index.json (category label from a sibling; keywords from the page's real headings).
Add <li> to the category card in index.html.
After committing the page: bash tools/sitemap.sh, then commit javabible/sitemap.xml.
Link from Related Topics of a sibling.
Update counts in index.html (meta, hero-stats, aria-label), README.md, CLAUDE.md, mcp/README.md.
bash tools/verify.sh; cd mcp && ./mvnw -q test; browser check.
addCategory: Add a <div class="category-card" id="{anchor}"> to index.html (id is mandatory, check 7). Optionally a link in .hero-quicklinks.
Search-index entries with a new category label.
Update CLAUDE.md category table and all category counts (index.html, README.md, CLAUDE.md). Also the list_categories description in JavaBibleTools.java ('all 13 categories').
addSiteWideJsFeature: New file in javabible/js/ wrapped in an IIFE ('use strict'), early-return if its DOM hooks are absent (pattern from search.js/toc.js).
No innerHTML with data, no console.*, no dependencies, respect prefers-reduced-motion for any animation.
Add the <script> tag by hand to every page that needs it — there is no include mechanism; 94 topic pages means 94 edits (use a scripted, reviewed sed and verify the diff).
Styles go in main.css (or a new css file linked everywhere), never inline.
changeSearch: Index shape changes must stay flat (verify.sh greps it) and must be mirrored in mcp/JavaBibleTools.java, which reads the same file and duplicates the scoring weights.

knownIssues.what: 'user' kept on purpose where it is the security principal (Spring Boot's default user is literally 'user', role USER, /user/**). Toy User models were renamed to Customer in 31 pages on 2026-11-23.
log4j-core 2.24.0 labelled 'always the latest patch' — version not re-checked against current releases.
Only the facts touched on 2026-11-23 were re-verified (spring.factories removal in Boot 3.0, CDI jakarta package, spring.session.store-type removal). Other version claims are unreviewed.
Keywords were enriched automatically from each page's h2/h3 headings; they are broad, not curated. 'records' has no dedicated page.

workingAgreements: Delivery format per CLAUDE.md: Entendido / Análisis / Propuesta / Plan de implementación / Auto-revisión crítica (the user writes in Spanish; site content is English).
Do not commit scratch/audit files; check git status before committing.
Commit or push only when asked.
